name: openviking-handoff-source-observation
title: OpenViking Handoff Source Observation
description: Add an explicit official OpenViking CLI-backed semantic checkpoint for Pennix formal handoff archive/extraction convergence, preserving Trellis ownership and all-or-nothing target intake. The checkpoint runs while the sealed source session is still live; it must not install a SessionEnd Hook, migrate sessions, copy memory, delete remote data, read plugin-private state, or modify OpenViking source.
